text: Resonates with the power from Elite storm Goblin Giant Axe, and continuously unleashes Whirlwind Strike, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and pulling in all surrounding units. After the skill is cast, your <style="accent-gn">Wind DMG</style> is increased for a period.

Consumes 40 Energy to channel forest power for 4s, healing the caster and up to 10 nearby allies over time. Healed targets also gain 15% All Element Resistance for 10s.

Tips: A strong healing skill for high-pressure moments. Since it requires channeling, time your cast carefully.

Chants for 2.9s, then consumes 20 Ice Energy to summon an intense Blizzard at the target location, continuously dealing Magic DMG and applying Frost to all enemies within the area.

Tips: This devastating AoE skill is most effective when used against immobilized enemies to maximize DMG dealt.

Immediately resets the CD of Healing <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style>s and grants <style="accent-gn">50</style> <style="accent-gn">Energy</style>. While active, surrounds you with verdant energy, increasing ATK, reducing skill <style="accent-gn">Energy</style> costs, and each <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext> cast shortens the remaining CD of Healing <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style>s.

In normal state, regenerates Flame Energy over time. Once full, the Ultimate becomes available, entering Scorching Flame state upon use.
Scorching Flame
Basic Attack, secondary skill, and main skill with enhanced forms.
Phoenix's Vigor
The lower your HP, the faster your Attack SPD.
Ignition
This skill has a chance to Ignite enemies on hit, dealingFire DMG over time and restoring a small amount of Flame Energy.
"Let the flames cleanse the world-unleashing a torrential blaze that cannot be stopped."

Pro Tips: The passive skill works best with shield-based weapons or talents. Higher ATK SPD enhances shield effects.

Unleashes raging Thunder within, generating 20 Blade Intent per second. When in this state, using Expertise Skills that consume Blade Intent triggers a Lightning Strike, dealing Attack DMG to the current target.

Tips: Pair with Thundercut to generate more Thunder strikes. Higher Mastery significantly increases Moonblade DMG for the Moonstrike Spec.

Thunderburst Oblivion
Launches an Oblivion Bomb that detonates after a short flight or on impact, unleashing a destructive burst of Lightning area damage. Immediately maxes out the weapon's heat gauge upon cast.

Pro Tips: Cast from a safe distance to unlock a brief window of massive Attack.

Leaps forward with a mighty swing, striking enemies along the path and dealing Rock DMG. Launches yourself into midair, allowing for a follow-up Plunge Attack

Pro Tips: Hit, jump, then drop the Hammer Blow.

Empowered <linktext=1539><style="ItemQuality_5">​Granite Fury​</style></linktext> channels the Power of Rock to summon a massive boulder from above, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">800%</style> ATK to the enemies within range (which scales with the Level/Tier of <linktext=1539><style="ItemQuality_5">​Granite Fury​</style></linktext>) and always triggering Crit.

Photon Energy
Initial max Photon Energy is 100. Once full, performing a Special Attack will activate Photon Reforge state, consuming 25 Photon Energy per second. The state ends when Photon Energy reaches 0. During this state, certain skills gain enhanced effects.

Basic Attack: Bullseye
Quickly draw the bow to fire up to four consecutive arrows, each dealing Attack DMG. When not in Photon Reforge state, the attack restores 2 Photon Energy.

Tips: Use Basic Attack to build up Photon Energy.

Fires a rain of arrows over a target area, dealing continuous Attack DMG. Grants 20 Photon Energy upon cast, plus 2 additional Photon Energy per enemy hit, up to 10 extra.

Tips: The more enemies hit, the more energy you gain.

Peaceful Tune
A magical melody that, whenever DMG is dealt, restores HP equal to 20% of the DMG dealt, distributed evenly among up to 5 allies (Party Members Prioritized).
Allies at full HP will not be included in the healing targets. If all Allies are at full HP, the healing will be considered as excess healing.
Performance Energy: Energy required to play Melody skills (Heroic Melody and Healing Melody). 1 point is regenerated per second.
Performance Passion: Required to perform music. 1 point is regenerated every 5s.

Basic Attack: Resonant Strings
Strums the strings to emit a scorching soundwave, dealing long-range Magic DMG to the enemy.

Tips: Using Basic Attacks when Performance Passion and Performance Energy are not maxed out provides consistent healing. Pair with talents to store this healing for emergency use.

My Passion Still Burns! Consumes 5 stacks of Performance Passion to summon a randomly shaped graffiti on the ground, healing 10 allies (party members prioritized) and dealing Magic DMG to the enemies within range.
While standing within the graffiti, the caster gains 10% Fire Bonus.
Only 1 graffiti can exist at a time.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. 1 point is regenerated every 5s.

Tips: This skill has the widest range for both healing and DMG. Cast it once the CD ends for max effectiveness.

A soothing melody. When Performance Energy exceeds 15, you can start the performance freely and stop at will. Each time you start, a speaker is deployed to perform a Concerto. (Speaker disappears when Healing Melody ends.) CD: 5s.
While performing Healing Melody, consumes 3 Performance Energy per second, and heals 10 allies every 1 second (Interval affected by Haste).

Speaker: When you cast Healing Beat, Fivefold Crescendo, Rock the Stage, Concert Circuit, the speaker will simultaneously cast the same skill.

Performance Energy: Required to play Melody skills (Heroic Melody, Healing Melody). Regenerates 1 point per second.

Tips: Mastering where and when to place the speaker is essential.

Resonates with Airona's soul power. After a short chant, revives all Allies within 20 meters.
[Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 100s]

Summons Boss: Iron Fang to deal a large instance of AoE Attack DMG to nearby enemies, inflicting Wound on affected targets.

Skill is not affected by CD.
Instantly heals yourself and nearby <style="accent-gn">allies</style>, and randomly <style="accent-gn">dispel</style> a <linktext=1094><style="ItemQuality_5">debuff</style></linktext>.
Sees through enemies' all weaknesses, entering True Sight state. While active, gains increased <style="accent-gn">critical rate</style>.

<style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Phantom Arachnocrab and transforms into a cocoon. Following a brief delay, the cocoon bursts, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> the actions of the affected target. Your <style="accent-gn">Mastery</style> is increased for a period.

Summons Boss: Flamehorn to repeatedly ram the target with its horns, dealing Attack DMG.
Grants a Luck effect: Triggering a Lucky Strike causes an explosion at the target's location, dealing Magic DMG (cooldown: 0.1s), and immediately grants the Absolute Luck effect. For the duration, Absolute Luck's cooldown becomes 5s.

Summons Elite: Blackstone Commander to call down lightning from the sky, dealing Magic DMG.
For a period of time after the skill is cast, when you deal damage, you will also deal additional Attack DMG to the target equal to a percentage of your Armor (can trigger at most once every 1s).
Tap to exit the current transformation.

Summons Kartgriff to deal Magic DMG.
After casting, temporarily grants a Main Stats and Healing Received boost to you and up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates).
(Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s.)

Summons Boss: Bloodthirsty Furball to deal Attack DMG.
For a period of time after casting, every time your Class Skills and Luck effect deal damage, they add extra damage on top of the skill's base value, equal to a certain percentage of your ATK.

Summons Elite: Verdant Fang to deal Attack DMG.
For a period of time after casting, each Class Skill used reduces your remaining Ultimate CD (triggers up to once every 1s).

Summons Elite: Dogorman, dealing Attack DMG equal to a percentage of your HP.
After casting, your HP is also temporarily increased.
Enter magnetic mode after activation. When close to another floating eyeball in magnetic mode, you can instantly attach to it and move synchronously with the target!
A leap combining power and beauty, leaving a beautiful arc! CD rate +100% while sprinting, and restores all charges of Dash after use.
Step forward and sprint with the wind! Charge rate +100% while sprinting. Holds up to 2 charges.
Ignite, take off, thrusters accelerate forward!
The winter sprite leaps skyward, tracing shimmering trails across the skies!

Consumes 10 HP to attack with Fafala's sword.
If the attack hits a Stalker, restores 50 HP.
Killing a Stalker fully restores HP.
Cannot be used when HP is insufficient.
The actual damage is calculated based on the Armor of the object the Stalker has transformed into.
Weapon Special Effect: Nearby Stalkers continuously restore HP and gain increased movement speed.
"I hope this brings you some peace..."
